entries.en: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
entries.translated: Gå bara ur min väg! Du dödade denna vackra varelse. Jag har inget mer att säga. Crunors jävla druid!

entries.en: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!

entries.en: Well, bye then.
entries.translated: Nåväl, hejdå då.

entries.en: May your path always be even.
entries.translated: Må din väg alltid vara jämn.

entries.en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
entries.translated: Välkommen, unga |PLAYERNAME|! Om du är svårt sårad eller förgiftad kan jag {heal} dig gratis.

entries.en: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
